title: A part added after the release is priced as it was before
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit', 'Work Orders — Order Parts' and 'Work Order Lines — Create & Edit'.
  • Use the staging site, where the Tiered Pricing release is deployed on top of data from before the release.
  • Have on staging a work order created before the release with a part line priced by its category's matrix; its price details read "Priced before tiers". Note its category, cost and unit sell price (for example Filters, $40.00, $56.00).
  • Make sure that category's matrix shows no Rule Changed event in its Audit Log since the release.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, left on Default.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, with one labor line (line 1).
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Click Add Part under line 1.
  3. Type a description in Description (for example Test part).
  4. Type 1 in Qty.
  5. Pick the noted category in Category.
  6. Type the noted cost in Cost.
  7. Click Save.
  8. Point at the new line's sell price.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens with no part lines.

Step 2:

  • A new part row opens under line 1 with Part number, Description, Qty, Category, Cost and Sell price boxes and Save and Cancel.

Step 3:

  • Description holds the typed text.

Step 4:

  • Qty holds 1.

Step 5:

  • Category shows the noted category.

Step 6:

  • Cost holds the noted cost as typed.

Step 7:

  • The new line's unit sell price equals the noted price ($56.00 = $56.00), unless the noted price came from a half-cent tie, which is now one cent higher.

Step 8:

  • The price details name Default as what priced the line, not "Priced before tiers".
